title: The Fake News Drone
logline: An ambitious reporter hires a pilot to protect their fabricated news broadcast drone from a tired editor trying to shoot it down.

roles.description: Loud, completely unprincipled, views truth as a suggestion.
Exhausted, heavily caffeinated, just wants to avoid lawsuits.
A massive orbital broadcasting hub covered in satellite dishes.
A heavily armored automated transmitter blasting clickbait.

public_situation: A {role:propaganda_drone} is broadcasting a completely fabricated story about a non-existent mutant bioweapon outbreak near the {role:news_station}.
private_truth: The reporter built the drone to artificially boost their ratings, and the editor is desperately trying to destroy it before the station loses its broadcasting license.

beats.public_change: The station's automated defense turrets begin tracking the drone.

missions.reason: The reporter hires the pilot to buy and deliver signal scramblers to the station to blind its turrets.
missions.private_fact: The scramblers accidentally knock out the station's legitimate emergency broadcasts.

beats.public_change: The editor personally boards a maintenance skiff with a plasma rifle.

missions.reason: The editor hires the pilot to scan the drone to find its remote control frequency so they can shut it down.
missions.private_fact: The ambitious reporter built and programmed the attack drone to manufacture breaking news crises and secure a prime anchor slot.

beats.public_change: The editor lines up a clear shot at the drone.

missions.reason: The editor begs the pilot to deliver a massive EMP charge to the station's main transmitter to permanently blind the drone.
missions.private_fact: The EMP will also knock out the station's ability to broadcast for a month.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot is ready to plant the EMP. The reporter is offering a cut of the massive ad revenue to walk away.

options.label: Plant the EMP and stop the fake news
Walk away and take the ad revenue

resolutions.summary: The drone is destroyed. The fake news broadcast stops, the station keeps its license, and the reporter is fired.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot blew up a rogue broadcast drone to stop a fabricated panic.

resolutions.summary: The drone finishes its broadcast. A massive public panic ensues, the reporter gets promoted to lead anchor, and the editor quits in despair.
The editor misses the shot. The drone broadcasts unabated, causing a massive stampede that destroys the station's docks.

loose_threads.detail: The drone is entirely composed of stolen deep-mining robotics.
The editor accidentally admits they only care because they were bribed by a rival network to keep ratings low.

radio_hooks: Panic spreads as reports of mutant bioweapon outbreak flood the sector.
{role:tired_editor} issues frantic apologies on all frequencies.

voice_direction.ambitious_reporter: Fast, loud, speaks entirely in headlines.
voice_direction.tired_editor: Slow, utterly defeated, sounds like they haven't slept in days.
